response rate is an increasing function of obtained reward density in an environment that is open with respect to food, and that the form of this function is hyperbolic.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the relation between response and reinforcement is a function of the economy, and the economy is a function of reinforcement.
the effects of reinforcement rate and access time are independent of each other.
reward density is a useful measure for the open economy and that the relation between response rates and reward density is a hyperbolic function.

the form of the function relating response rate to reward density is the same for open and closed economies, but that the function is steeper for the former.
